devdoc.author: Set Protocol Smart contract global extension which provides DelegatedManager operator(s) the ability to wrap ERC20 and Ether positions via third party protocols. Some examples of wrap actions include wrapping, DAI to cDAI (Compound) or Dai to aDai (AAVE).

params._delegatedManager: Instance of the DelegatedManager to initialize
Instance of the DelegatedManager to initialize the WrapModuleV2 for
Instance of the DelegatedManager to initialize

params._integrationName: ID of wrap module integration (mapping on integration registry)
params._unwrapData: Arbitrary bytes to pass into the WrapV2Adapter
params._wrappedToken: Address of the component to be unwrapped
params._wrappedUnits: Quantity of wrapped tokens in Position units

params._integrationName: ID of wrap module integration (mapping on integration registry)
params._unwrapData: Arbitrary bytes to pass into the WrapV2Adapter
params._wrappedToken: Address of the component to be unwrapped
params._wrappedUnits: Quantity of wrapped tokens in Position units

params._integrationName: Name of wrap module integration (mapping on integration registry)
params._underlyingToken: Address of the component to be wrapped
params._underlyingUnits: Quantity of underlying units in Position units
params._wrapData: Arbitrary bytes to pass into the WrapV2Adapter
params._wrappedToken: Address of the desired wrapped token

params._integrationName: Name of wrap module integration (mapping on integration registry)
params._underlyingUnits: Quantity of underlying units in Position units
params._wrapData: Arbitrary bytes to pass into the WrapV2Adapter
params._wrappedToken: Address of the desired wrapped token

devdoc.title: GlobalWrapExtension

methods.constructor: Instantiate with ManagerCore address and WrapModuleV2 address.

initializeExtension(address).notice: ONLY OWNER: Initializes WrapExtension to the DelegatedManager.

initializeModule(address).notice: ONLY OWNER: Initializes WrapModuleV2 on the SetToken associated with the DelegatedManager.

initializeModuleAndExtension(address).notice: ONLY OWNER: Initializes WrapExtension to the DelegatedManager and TradeModule to the SetToken

removeExtension().notice: ONLY MANAGER: Remove an existing SetToken and DelegatedManager tracked by the WrapExtension

unwrap(address,address,address,uint256,s.notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Instructs the SetToken to unwrap a wrapped asset into its underlying via a specified adapter.

unwrapWithEther(address,address,uint256,.notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Instructs the SetToken to unwrap a wrapped asset collateralized by Ether into Wrapped Ether. Since external protocol will send back Ether that Ether must be Wrapped into WETH in order to be accounted for by SetToken.

wrap(address,address,address,uint256,str.notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Instructs the SetToken to wrap an underlying asset into a wrappedToken via a specified adapter.

wrapWithEther(address,address,uint256,st.notice: ONLY OPERATOR: Instructs the SetToken to wrap Ether into a wrappedToken via a specified adapter. Since SetTokens only hold WETH, in order to support protocols that collateralize with Ether the SetToken's WETH must be unwrapped first before sending to the external protocol.
